description: Source code for the 'Redis' cache class in the Opencart system, providing methods to interact with Redis for caching purposes.

classes.name: Redis
classes.description: A class that encapsulates Redis caching functionality for OpenCart.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Redis connection and sets the expiration time for cache entries.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry by key and decodes the JSON data into a PHP array or value.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache by key, encoding it as JSON, and sets expiration if specified.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by key.
